tools.name: ldm_health
tools.description: Check LDM.delivery API health. No auth required.

tools.name: ldm_terms
tools.description: Fetch the LDM user agreement text (plain). Show it to the user before calling ldm_register. No auth required.

tools.name: ldm_register
tools.description: Bootstrap a new LDM workspace for the user (no API key needed). Requires the user to have read the agreement (ldm_terms) and accept it. Creates a PENDING account, emails a confirmation link to `email`, and returns an ldm_* API key with read + safe-draft scopes (sending email needs the owner to expand scopes after activation). Reconnect your MCP client with the returned key. Rate-limited per IP. Pass `website` (company site on the email domain) to get automatic activation; without it the signup needs a questionnaire and an admin approval.

email.description: The user's email — the confirmation link is sent here.

termsAccepted.description: Must be true; the user accepted the agreement from ldm_terms.

website.description: Optional but decisive: the company website on the SAME domain as `email` (e.g. https://acme.com for user@acme.com). With it, a corporate signup activates automatically once the email is confirmed. Without it — or with a freemail address — the signup goes to a short questionnaire and waits for an admin.

use_case.description: Optional: what the user wants to do (one line).
